hard_rules.detail: FormulaGen must assemble candidates from approved_subgraph_id values, not ad hoc raw expression strings.
Direct Field or raw expression creation is rejected unless it resolves to an approved CORE2 subgraph_id.
CORE2 factor_candidate_root nodes are diagnostic/repair roots only until response promotion and replay gates pass.
label_only, future, timing-blocked, or missing-contract fields remain fail-closed.
diagnostic_only and risk_defense_only nodes cannot enter ordinary alpha queues.
May labels, returns, pass/fail flags, or stress margins are forbidden in generation, mutation, ranking, or selector score.
